# What the shape tells you

<!-- STEP id="straight" -->
Straight line: in equal time intervals, such as 2 s to 3 s and 5 s to 6 s, the displacements are equal, 20 m each. The velocity is constant.

<!-- STEP id="curve" -->
Curve: in equal time intervals, such as 4 s to 6 s and 10 s to 12 s, the displacements grow, from 5 m to 11 m. The velocity is changing, so the motion is accelerated.
